```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 09_power_alternative_means
title: >
  Alternative Hypothesis z-scores
questions:
  - id: alternative_z_scores
    type: free-response
    prompt: >
      If the alternative-hypothesis mean is 55 and the standard error is 2, what
      z-scores correspond to critical means of 46.08 and 53.92?
    answer: >
      Relative to the alternative distribution, the z-scores are (46.08 - 55) / 2 =
      -4.46 and (53.92 - 55) / 2 = -0.54.
    explanation: >
      These z-scores locate the null critical means inside the alternative
      distribution.
```
